description: Turns your sidebar sections into a workflow agents follow, with unread work collected in the right inbox. Name stages, write their rules, and add entry prompts to start a review or another step when a thread arrives. Create inboxes for individual plugins; the main Inbox catches other idle unread threads and returns them to their stage when work resumes or a message is queued. Agents move their own threads with one command, and command-line configuration changes ask for your approval before saving.
